sourcePolicy.supplemental: ESPN public site API + OpenFootball public-domain datasets + OpenFoot fallback
sourcePolicy.coverageEngine: ESPN current-window refresh + rotating future-calendar slices preserved across snapshots
sourcePolicy.detailEnrichment: TheSportsDB V1 free API (existing matches only; no team identity/logo authority)
sourcePolicy.cacheStrategy: GitHub Actions snapshot; visitors never call providers
sourcePolicy.note: ESPN endpoint is public/undocumented; OpenFootball is schedule/results-only; OpenFoot is a quota-limited fallback for selected leagues. Neither source overrides verified provider identity or logos.

logoPolicy.identityKey: provider namespace + immutable numeric/string provider team ID
logoPolicy.collisionPolicy: different provider identities sharing a logo are replaced by UI Avatars
